system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 20. 3 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (39 seconds, code score 0.85) ---
[b00] SEAMUS (desperate, grieving): "You are a viscount's daughter!"
[b01] SEAMUS (pleading): "Sleeping on straw, sorting weeds!"
[b02] SEAMUS (frustrated): "Let the village tend to itself for once!"
[b03] JULIANA (passionate, unflinching): "The chapel is gone, Seamus. I am the only healer these people have left."
[b04] JULIANA (unyielding): "I keep the basket."
[b05] SEAMUS (saddened, heartbroken): "They have reduced you to a peasant."
[b06] JULIANA (proud, indomitable): "They have reduced me to myself."
[b07] JULIANA (steely): "And I am not finished."
[b08] ACTION: Catherine's gloved hand sets her fine porcelain teacup down onto the silver tray with a delicate clatter.
[b09] SFX: Sharp porcelain chime of teacup meeting saucer.
[b10] CATHERINE (cruel, callous): "Let the peasants rot in their barns."
[b11] CATHERINE (mocking, spiteful): "Let them pray to their weeds."
[b12] RUPERT (intimate, reassuring): "You have no rival here, Catherine."
[b13] RUPERT (fawning): "No one to stand in your way."
[b14] CATHERINE (triumphant, greedy): "Once the old Duchess is gone..."
[b15] CATHERINE (possessive): "...Ashbury will finally belong to us."
[b16] ACTION: Catherine rises from her chair in one regal motion and glides toward the towering window overlooking the vast estate grounds.
[b17] CATHERINE (cold, ruthless): "This house will only bow to me."

--- WINDOW 1 (44 seconds, code score 0.82) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (taunting, silkily): "Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?"
[b01] RUPERT (flirtatious, sly): "Only if it sweetens your disposition, Catherine."
[b02] RUPERT (boastful, confident): "The estate is practically ours."
[b03] RUPERT (smug): "The succession papers are being finalized as we speak."
[b04] CATHERINE (cold, haughty): "'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke."
[b05] CATHERINE (stern, ambitious): "I marry the Lord of Ashbury."
[b06] RUPERT (reassuring, firm): "And so you shall."
[b07] RUPERT (dark, conspiratorial): "Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown..."
[b08] RUPERT (decisive): "...the title is mine."
[b09] CATHERINE (wary, inquiring): "And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes."
[b10] CATHERINE (disdainful): "Her shadow still hangs over this house."
[b11] RUPERT (quiet, sinister): "Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled."
[b12] RUPERT (gloating): "They call it a wasting of the lungs."
[b13] CATHERINE (mock-sympathetic, cruel): "How tragic. The slow, quiet decline."
[b14] CATHERINE (scheming): "How much longer can the frail thing survive?"
[b15] RUPERT (cold, callous): "Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort."
[b16] CATHERINE (vindictive): "Good. The village is already whispering about her."
[b17] CATHERINE (contemptuous): "The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes."

--- WINDOW 2 (37 seconds, code score 0.81) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (scheming): "How much longer can the frail thing survive?"
[b01] RUPERT (cold, callous): "Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort."
[b02] CATHERINE (vindictive): "Good. The village is already whispering about her."
[b03] CATHERINE (contemptuous): "The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes."
[b04] CATHERINE (disgusted): "They disgust me."
[b05] RUPERT (dismissive, arrogant): "They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots."
[b06] RUPERT (authoritative, promising): "They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown."
[b07] ACTION: The barn door opens, revealing daylight outside. SEAMUS, an older weathered villager in a waistcoat, carries a wooden bucket inside, his expression etched with deep sorrow and concern.
[b08] SEAMUS (gentle, concerned): "Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana."
[b09] SEAMUS (empathetic): "Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft."
[b10] ACTION: Seamus reaches down to take the handle of the basket from her.
[b11] JULIANA (fierce, resolute): "If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins."
[b12] JULIANA (defiant): "I do not yield to a cold draft."
[b13] SEAMUS (desperate, grieving): "You are a viscount's daughter!"
[b14] SEAMUS (pleading): "Sleeping on straw, sorting weeds!"

Pick the single best promo.
